channel.description: Latest articles from South Coast Business Awards 2018 (dailyecho.co.uk)

item.title: The owner of New Forest Fruit Snacks on his innovative treats
item.description: The CEO of the New Forest Fruit Co and New Forest Fruit Snacks talks about growing his businesses, his innovative treats, and the importance of buying British

item.title: Great photos show Echo readers enjoying much-loved Southampton venue
item.description: The Way Out West summer party was held at the entertainment complex in Ocean Village, in conjunction with neighbouring diner Mustang Sally's.

item.title: 'Friendly ghost' returns to Hampshire pub
item.description: A video shows a 'ghost' shattering a glass in the Village Home Pub in Gosport as shocked punters watch on.

item.title: Butchers stored burger buns on raw dog food and beef bones
item.description: A food hygiene report stated that Portchester Butchers stored burger buns on top of raw dog food and beef bones.

item.title: Warning issued as council considers selling free car park near station
item.description: Concerns have been raised over the sale of a council-owned car park near a suburban Southampton railway station.

item.title: Southampton researchers honoured by King and Queen at St James's Palace
item.description: A team of Southampton researchers have been honoured by the King and Queen for more than two decades of rail research.

item.title: University to introduce plant-based menus as default on campus
item.description: Plant-based food will become the default menu choice at the University of Southampton campuses after a student council vote in response to the climate crisis.

item.title: Man, 82, who 'enjoys' child abuse images found with over 70,000
item.description: A man who admitted to 'enjoying' child abuse images has appeared in court after being found with so many that police gave up counting them all

item.title: Man accused of spitting at officer after murder arrest over dad's death
item.description: A man alleged to have assaulted a police officer after being told to take his boxers off in a police cell, after being arrested for his father's murder

item.title: Resident's anger after getting parking fine outside his own house
item.description: A man said he is being pushed out of his home after the council began ticketing residents for parking outside their own houses, leaving them 'running the risk of endless parking fines'.
